idea: Shot 1: wide shot of a dark castle on a stormy cliff at dusk; a young woman in a crimson cloak with a long white braid walks toward the huge gate. Shot 2: in a candlelit throne room an old king with a grey beard and a black fur mantle turns to her and says: "You came back. After everything I said, you actually came back." Shot 3: she steps closer and answers: "I did not come back for you, Father. I came back for the dragon."

script.title: Return to the Keep
script.logline: An exiled princess returns to her estranged father's storm-battered castle, not for reconciliation, but to claim the caged beast beneath it.
script.setting: A gloomy, gothic stone fortress perched over a raging ocean cliff at dusk, lit inside by guttering torches and tall tallow candles.

characters.name: Lyra
characters.look: Lyra, 22 years old, sharp pale cheekbones, piercing icy blue eyes, a thick waist-length snow-white braid, wearing a heavy crimson velvet hooded cloak over fitted black leather armor.
characters.voiceDescription: cold clear female voice, early 20s, neutral English accent, measured and unyielding

characters.name: King Alden
characters.look: King Alden, 62 years old, deeply lined scarred face, long untamed iron-grey beard, tarnished gold circlet crown, wearing an imposing jet-black wolf-fur mantle over battered chainmail.
characters.voiceDescription: gravelly weathered male voice, early 60s, Northern British accent, heavy and rasping

shots.visual: A colossal obsidian fortress looms on a jagged sea cliff beneath stormy violet dusk, while Lyra in her vibrant crimson cloak and thick white braid advances toward the colossal iron gate.
shots.motion: slow tilt-up from the cliff path to the towering battlements

shots.visual: Inside the cavernous, shadow-drenched throne room lit by towering torches, King Alden rises slightly from his jagged iron throne, his weathered gaze fixed forward.
shots.line: You came back. After everything I said, you actually came back.
shots.speaker: King Alden

cuts.visual: Inside the cavernous, shadow-drenched throne room lit by towering torches, King Alden rises slightly from his jagged iron throne, his weathered gaze fixed forward.
King Alden's scarred brow furrows under his tarnished crown as his lips tremble with fragile hope and sorrow.

shots.visual: Lyra steps into the torchlight with deliberate grace, snow melting on the deep crimson velvet shoulders of her cloak.
shots.motion: slow push-in into her resolute expression
shots.line: I did not come back for you, Father. I came back for the dragon.
shots.speaker: Lyra
